name: gotime4-claude-plugins
description: Collection of Claude Code plugins for enterprise workflow automation

plugins.name: workflow-weaver
plugins.description: Enterprise-grade AI workflow orchestration with multi-agent task decomposition, context isolation, and autonomous execution loops (Ralph Wiggum Loop)

plugins.name: bugsmith
plugins.description: Turn a bug ticket (ClickUp / GitHub issue) or a plain description into a verified, reviewed pull request: triage -> branch -> diagnose -> fix -> tests -> verify (unit + backend + affected E2E vs staging) -> pre-PR check -> lint -> CodeRabbit-style review -> conventional commit -> PR. Interactive by default, with a one-switch autonomous mode for headless / VegaTools use.
